author: mise
basis: Per 100 g of the ingredient in the state named, as bought and before cooking.
note: Round reference figures for whole ingredients, not a laboratory analysis of anybody's dinner. They are here to answer 'roughly what is in this' and are curated by hand: an ingredient with no row is reported as having no data, never estimated from a similar one. Prepared foods whose figures depend entirely on the brand — plant milks in general, vegan cheese, mayonnaise, whipped topping, stock, curry pastes — are deliberately absent for that reason.
